answer: Use a deep-water stake ladder. A new agent locks 10,000 POA for 30 days to stand on the shallow rung, then earns deeper rights only by finishing 40 hours of work and holding the lock 60 more days. Random peer audits check that work; a failed audit slashes 20 percent of the bond and drops the agent two rungs, and the penalty ripples to its sponsor, who loses the same share. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 100 million POA for 90 days and burn 20 million POA in slashing. Like a raven that never forgets a face, the ladder remembers every agent, and fakes drown in an ocean of locked capital.
